metadata.title: Real Determinantal and Segre Varieties: Stability and Area Minimization
metadata.abstract: We apply Liu's recently introduced moderation criterion to complete the classification of area-minimizing real determinantal varieties and real Segre varieties, thereby settling the remaining cases left open by Pedersen and Kerckhove--Lawlor \cite{Pedersen93,KerckhoveLawlor1999}. In particular, we prove that $C(2,3,1)$ is area-minimizing modulo $2$, resolving the $g=4$, $(m_1,m_2)=(1,1)$ case of the isoparametric focal-cone problem raised by Tang and Zhang \cite{TZ20} and recently revisited by Liu \cite{Liu2026}.

analysis.breakthrough: 特别证明 C(2,3,1) 模2面积极小，对应 g=4、重数 (1,1) 的等参焦锥情形。
analysis.limitations: 模2极小与有向整数系数极小的适用结论须分别核对。摘要未列完整分类参数表，分类完成是作者本稿主张。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
